comment: Single-cylinder four-stroke engine, OHV with pushrods and rockers, camshaft in the crankcase driven by a gear train (crank gear, idler, cam gear), 2 valves, flywheel magneto: a machine made of a drawing. Same crank train, cylinder and magneto as the OHC engine. Mechanism frame: crank axis Z, cylinder axis +X; the model is turned upright (X -> world Z). Lengths in metres, angles in degrees. Drawn at the firing TDC (cycle angle 0).

comment: Materials: density drives the masses, the rest the appearance.
Rigid bodies and their rest placement in the mechanism frame (assembled, at the firing TDC). The frame is the ground; a spring body only holds a spring (stretched between its ends).
Connecting rod (rod frame: crank pin at the origin, small end on +X).
Piston assembly (piston frame: wrist pin centre, cylinder axis +X).
Fixed housings (cut by the section view).
Valve train: camshaft (cam frame at the cam centre, turning about Z at half crank speed), lobes drawn by the cam law, timing drive.
Valves (valve frame: seat on the deck, axis +X), bucket tappets, retainers, springs (spring frame: seat on the head, compressed along X by the lift).
Magneto stator: the field solver's core and coil.
Spark plug (axis at 35 deg in the XY plane), HT lead, intake and exhaust (they leave the head behind the section plane).
Pushrod valve train: gear timing drive (crank gear, idler on its pin, cam gear), tappets, pushrods, rockers on the rocker shaft (drawn in the mechanism frame), the rocker box and the timing case.
The machine: joints (how the bodies move), the starter on the main bearing, valve seats as stops.

Elements: friction and load on the crank, the timing drive, the cams and the valve springs (stiffness from the drawn coils), the gas chamber (bore, volume and valves measured on the parts) and the magneto (field from the drawn magnet and core).
